summary: Senior Product Designer operating at principal scope with 15 years designing enterprise data platforms where complex workflows become manageable, including supply-side and partner-facing systems at Wellhub and Vividly. At Dataminr, led end-to-end redesign of a multi-tenant configuration system serving 100,000+ security analysts: 65% reduction in manager configuration time and 45% drop in support tickets. At Vividly, owned multi-product-area design for a financial analytics platform tracking thousands of products, promotions, and budgets, while leading a design system team of 2 designers and 5 engineers. Bringing that research-first, system-level approach to supply-side partner-facing UX. Portfolio and case studies at studiocartelli.com.

bullets: Founded a consultancy delivering production-ready design systems for technical founders building B2B SaaS, applying enterprise-scale practices from Dataminr and Vividly to fixed 2–4 week sprints.
Build every engagement around developer-ready components and documented specs instead of standalone screens, so client engineering teams can implement without back-and-forth.
Shipped a complete Figma design system and documentation.
Grew the Figma component library 4x, from 32 to 140 components.
Designed and shipped skills for Claude and Figma, a four-mode tool (spec, build, explore, prototype) for product designers, from brief through delivery.
In an early case, cut prototype-to-handoff time in half, letting the engineering team ship in half the time.
Adoption spread organically, with engineers using the tool across their own repos.
Owned the multi-product-area design for a financial analytics platform, tracking metrics across thousands of products, promotions, budgets, and financial forecasts.
Reduced manual workflows from days to hours through customized reports, aggregated metrics, and advanced filtering.
Led design system team of 2 designers and 5 engineers to unify design and functionality throughout the platform.
Introduced historical and predicted trend analysis to forecasting workflows.
Added bulk actions, automations, and improved validation to complex data tables, cutting user-error support requests ~35% and reducing staff time spent on manual corrections by 4 hours/week.
Introduced pre/post-mortems, phased project timelines, and formalized project documentation.
Improved the platform to support third-party API integrations.
Led design for a human-in-the-loop medical document and data analysis tool.

Led mixed-method discovery (interviews and surveys across sorting, analyst, and QA roles) that diagnosed a recurring data-entry error pattern and defined an automation-first redesign with measurable success criteria (throughput, model confidence, override rate).
Built the company's first design system, improving overall platform consistency.
Redesigned onboarding, reducing setup abandonment. Previously a common drop-off point for new users.
Shipped a reference checking feature closing a competitive gap. This helped close deals with new buyers.
Redesigned platform configuration serving 100,000+ security analysts: 65% reduction in manager configuration time and 45% drop in support tickets.
Led discovery across 8 security managers at 5 enterprise customers that reframed organizational debate through evidence-based stakeholder workshops, securing roadmap resources.
Designed progressive disclosure patterns reducing analyst alert noise 20% and duplicate workarounds 50%. Patterns deployed across 4 product interfaces.
Navigated 18–24 month migration risk through research-backed recommendation, preserving user mental models while unblocking enterprise expansion into 10,000+ user accounts.
Led discovery and design for a human-in-the-loop training tool for threat identification improvements.
Positioned monitoring improvements as a key differentiator in public-sector RFPs, removing the primary barrier to contract renewals.
Designed AI and ML features including a class recommendation engine.

Designed and helped ship an ML-based outlier-detection model to flag fraudulent partner check-ins (irregular timing, inconsistent usage patterns, account anomalies), giving Wellhub visibility for the first time into fraud exposure across a partner payout pool worth six figures annually.
Documented data flows for customers, users, and internal systems using service blueprints.
Partnered with product design and research teams in Brazil to localize designs, documentation, and surveys to American English.
Presented AI team processes and research at company retreat.
Designed interfaces for a data analytics platform serving a concentrated client base of major automotive manufacturers, managing large-scale data lakes.
Owned end-to-end design for data collection and bespoke alerting features, replacing a semi-automated process for a ~30-person analyst team.
Conducted user research and testing sessions to validate problems and solutions.
Mentored a junior designer on product design processes. Mentee was promoted within the year.
Led end-to-end design of a learning management system used by 15+ universities, supporting students, instructors, and administrators.
Established an accessibility-focused design system and designed digital asset management workflows.
